name: card
title: Card
description: A surface that groups related content about one object, optionally a link or a button as a whole.

when: Grouping content about one object on a page.
A whole tile that opens a page (href) or a panel (onPress).

instead.when: Only a boundary between groups is needed.

guidance.rule: An interactive card holds no controls except the header menu.

builtIn: An interactive card is one focusable element named by its header title.
youProvide: A CardHeader title, or `aria-label` on an interactive card without one.

genui.description: A surface grouping content about one object. Put a heading and text inside; do not nest cards.
